name: LiDAR balanced visual quality
notes: FloraWorld whole-map canopy uses authored near/far thresholds, so mesh LOD scale is 1 instead of the legacy 4. TSR 75%, virtual-shadow bias 1, four directional shadow rays and exclusion of non-Nanite foliage from coarse pages retained. Ray-traced effects and Lumen reflection policy follow project settings. CPU optimizations, 0.5 ms mud upload budget and 120 fps cap retained; 60 fps is the next measured target; the 120 fps cap is retained for headroom measurement. Full vegetation placement, native grass and driving physics retained. The main trees and saplings use a 110 m displacement cutoff and directional shadow clipmap bias -3. See Docs/LIDAR_ROUTE_SHADOWS_AND_BASE_PASS.md for driving measurements. The rain depth capture sleeps while global wetness, snow, and precipitation are all zero. LiDAR also uses per-instance depth-pyramid occlusion, with extra occlusion queries off. See Docs/LIDAR_VISIBILITY_AND_TREE_COSTS.md.
